summary: These two factors combined with access granted to children lead to little blogging corners all over the web. Then came Google and Blogger and G+ and things waned a bit in 2015. Yet today we are seeing a resurgence blogging in education never died.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: These two factors combined with access granted to children lead to little blogging corners all over the web. Then came Google and Blogger and G+ and things waned a bit in 2015. Yet today we are seeing a resurgence blogging in education never died.
